RequiresStatusDurationMutation.notes: custom_factions/status_duration_mutation_predicate_contracts.json covers every RequiresStatusDurationMutation effectKey and requires native status instance duration read/write or extension semantics rather than status taxonomy classification, status application alone, battle-start timing, spell text, fire/gating companions, cleanse events, or positive status names without live instance proof. Status query surfaces and explicit status taxonomy exist, but native status instance identity, duration read/write, owner/affected-stack correlation, source law-owner side correlation, battle-start or unit-turn timing, cleanup/expiration ordering, and per-status idempotence remain runtime-gated. Contract-backed matrix surface: contracts.statusDurationMutationPredicates.

RequiresSupportBlessingClassification.notes: Explicit spell taxonomy contract covers Daylight support/blessing/heal/cleanse/protection/defense/initiative seeds; morale-specific support remains an explicit taxonomy gap. Contract-backed matrix surface: contracts.spellClassificationPredicates.

RequiresTargetOutnumbered.notes: Source contract requires live numeric stack-size comparison for the current target in Outnumber; smaller army, lower tier, damaged stack, global unit counts, surrounded geometry, and counterattack events without target stack count proof are forbidden substitutes. Runtime proof is still required for stack identities, count comparison timing, doctrine/counterattack correlation, and owner correlation. Contract-backed matrix surface: contracts.dungeonTargetStatePredicates.

RequiresWarcryExecution.notes: custom_factions/warcry_execution_predicate_contracts.json covers every RequiresWarcryExecution effectKey and anchors Stronghold-only usage to custom_factions/homm3_stronghold.json skill_faction_homm3_stronghold; it forbids spell-cast, hero-ability-level, battle/round-start, morale-trigger, cooldown-preview, magic-school-access, generic-ability, and static-skill-ownership substitutes. Native Warcry execution event, executing hero owner/side, Warcry identity, success versus preview/failure, cooldown ordering, battle timing, and idempotent reward/tempo application remain runtime-gated. Contract-backed matrix surface: contracts.warcryExecutionPredicates.

RequiresWarcryOrRageEvent.notes: Contracted in tempo_event_predicate_contracts.json. Warcry config and morale surfaces are context only; gameplay remains blocked until committed Warcry execution or explicit Rage tempo event, damage/kill companion ordering, owner correlation, safe buff timing, and morale/static-skill substitute exclusion are runtime-proven.

RequiresWoundedUnit.notes: Contracted in combat_scalar_state_predicate_contracts.json. Damage events are context only; gameplay remains blocked until current health/max-health wounded threshold, safe speed refresh timing, cleanup, and stale snapshot exclusion are runtime-proven.
